question: A file, which is to archive and compress them into one file of smaller size using a program is called as ____.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**ZIP**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A file, which is to archive and compress them into one file of smaller size using a program is called as a **ZIP.**
 
• **ZIP **is an archive file format which supports compression of lossless data. There may be one or more files or directories in a ZIP file that may have been compressed.
 
• The ZIP file format allows a number of algorithms for compression, although the most common is DEFLATE.
 
• Originally created in 1989, this format was first implemented in the PKZIP utility of PKWARE, Inc. as a replacement for Thom Henderson's previous ARC compression format. Numerous software utilities other than PKZIP quickly supported the ZIP format then.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) **are cryptographic protocols designed to provide the security of communication over a computer network.
 
• **Software as a service(SAAS)** is a licensing and distribution model of software in which software is licensed and centrally hosted on a subscription basis.
 
• **Search engine optimization(SEO)** is the method of enhancing the quality and amount of website traffic from search engines to a website or a web page.
